  "description": "VAVA Project is a construction and property development operation under the broader VAVA Group, involving the development and management of residential and commercial properties, project sites, facilities, and related operational activities. From the work you have shared, the project has a significant focus on construction-site operations, architecture, engineering, security, procurement, administration, and human resource management.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Facility Manager

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Facilities/Administration
Reports To: Management/Head of Administration
Industry: Real Estate / Construction

About the Role


	We are seeking a competent, proactive, and experienced Facility Manager to oversee the efficient management, maintenance, safety, and day-to-day operations of the Company&#39;s facilities and properties.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that facilities, building systems, equipment, utilities, and common areas are properly maintained, safe, functional, and fit for purpose.
	The role will also involve coordinating vendors, contractors, service providers, maintenance teams, and other stakeholders to ensure that facility-related activities are delivered efficiently and cost-effectively.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and general management of the Company&#39;s facilities and properties.
	Develop and implement preventive and corrective maintenance plans for buildings, equipment, electrical systems, plumbing, air-conditioning systems, generators, water systems, elevators, fire safety systems, and other facility infrastructure.
	Conduct regular inspections of facilities to identify maintenance issues, safety hazards, defects, and areas requiring improvement.
	Coordinate repairs, maintenance, renovations, installations, and facility improvement projects.
	Supervise facility maintenance personnel, technicians, cleaners, security personnel, and other service providers where applicable.
	Coordinate and monitor external contractors, vendors, artisans, and service providers to ensure quality and timely delivery of services.
	Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment, warranties, service contracts, inspections, and facility assets.
	Monitor utility consumption, including electricity, water, fuel, and other facility-related resources, and recommend measures for cost efficiency.
	Ensure that facilities comply with applicable health, safety, environmental, fire, and other regulatory requirements.
	Develop and implement emergency response and business continuity procedures relating to facility operations.
	Monitor facility-related expenses and assist in preparing and managing maintenance and operational budgets.
	Obtain and evaluate quotations from vendors and contractors and make recommendations based on quality, cost, and service requirements.
	Ensure that maintenance materials, tools, equipment, and spare parts are properly managed and available when required.
	Respond promptly to facility emergencies, breakdowns, complaints, and urgent maintenance requirements.
	Maintain a preventive maintenance schedule and ensure that scheduled maintenance is carried out on time.
	Liaise with Management, HR, Finance, Security, Procurement, and other departments on facility-related matters.
	Ensure that the Company&#39;s facilities are clean, secure, functional, presentable, and maintained to the required standard.
	Prepare periodic facility management reports, including maintenance activities, incidents, outstanding repairs, expenses, and recommendations.
	Identify opportunities to improve facility efficiency, reduce operational costs, and extend the useful life of Company assets.
	Perform other facility-related duties as may be assigned by Management.


Qualifications


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Facility Management, Estate Management, Engineering, Building Technology, Quantity Surveying, Architecture, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
	3&ndash;5 years of relevant experience in facility management, property management, building operations, maintenance, or a related field.
	Professional certification in Facility Management, Project Management, Health &amp; Safety, or a related field will be an added advantage.


Experience:


	Experience managing contractors, vendors, maintenance personnel, and service providers.
	Practical knowledge of building maintenance, electrical systems, plumbing, HVAC, generators, water systems, and other building services.
	Good understanding of occupational health and safety, fire safety, emergency procedures, and facility compliance requirements.
	Experience with maintenance planning, budgeting, procurement, and vendor management.


Required Skills and Competencies:
The ideal candidate should possess:


	Strong facility and maintenance management skills.
	Excellent organisational and time-management abilities.
	Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to supervise and coordinate technical and non-technical personnel.
	Strong attention to detail and ability to identify potential facility risks.
	Ability to manage multiple maintenance activities and priorities simultaneously.
	Good negotiation and vendor-management skills.
	Ability to prepare clear reports and maintain accurate records.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
	Ability to work independently and demonstrate sound judgement.
	High level of integrity, accountability, professionalism, and reliability.
	Ability to respond effectively to emergencies and urgent operational situations.


What We Offer


	A professional and dynamic working environment.
	Opportunity to contribute to the effective management and improvement of Company facilities.
	Career growth and professional development opportunities.
	Competitive remuneration based on experience and qualifications.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: careers@vavaprojects.com using &quot;Facility Manager&quot; as the subject of the mail.",

Facility Manager Job at VAVA Project




        
    

        
        VAVA Project is a construction and property development operation under the broader VAVA Group, involving the development and management of residential and commercial properties, project sites, facilities, and related operational activities. From the work you have shared, the project has a significant focus on construction-site operations, architecture, engineering, security, procurement, administration, and human resource management.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Facility Manager

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Facilities/Administration
Reports To: Management/Head of Administration
Industry: Real Estate / Construction

About the Role


	We are seeking a competent, proactive, and experienced Facility Manager to oversee the efficient management, maintenance, safety, and day-to-day operations of the Company's facilities and properties.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that facilities, building systems, equipment, utilities, and common areas are properly maintained, safe, functional, and fit for purpose.
	The role will also involve coordinating vendors, contractors, service providers, maintenance teams, and other stakeholders to ensure that facility-related activities are delivered efficiently and cost-effectively.

	Oversee the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and general management of the Company's facilities and properties.
	Develop and implement preventive and corrective maintenance plans for buildings, equipment, electrical systems, plumbing, air-conditioning systems, generators, water systems, elevators, fire safety systems, and other facility infrastructure.
	Conduct regular inspections of facilities to identify maintenance issues, safety hazards, defects, and areas requiring improvement.
	Coordinate repairs, maintenance, renovations, installations, and facility improvement projects.
	Supervise facility maintenance personnel, technicians, cleaners, security personnel, and other service providers where applicable.
	Coordinate and monitor external contractors, vendors, artisans, and service providers to ensure quality and timely delivery of services.
	Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, equipment, warranties, service contracts, inspections, and facility assets.
	Monitor utility consumption, including electricity, water, fuel, and other facility-related resources, and recommend measures for cost efficiency.
	Ensure that facilities comply with applicable health, safety, environmental, fire, and other regulatory requirements.
	Develop and implement emergency response and business continuity procedures relating to facility operations.
	Monitor facility-related expenses and assist in preparing and managing maintenance and operational budgets.
	Obtain and evaluate quotations from vendors and contractors and make recommendations based on quality, cost, and service requirements.
	Ensure that maintenance materials, tools, equipment, and spare parts are properly managed and available when required.
	Respond promptly to facility emergencies, breakdowns, complaints, and urgent maintenance requirements.
	Maintain a preventive maintenance schedule and ensure that scheduled maintenance is carried out on time.
	Liaise with Management, HR, Finance, Security, Procurement, and other departments on facility-related matters.
	Ensure that the Company's facilities are clean, secure, functional, presentable, and maintained to the required standard.
	Prepare periodic facility management reports, including maintenance activities, incidents, outstanding repairs, expenses, and recommendations.

	Perform other facility-related duties as may be assigned by Management.

	3–5 years of relevant experience in facility management, property management, building operations, maintenance, or a related field.
	Professional certification in Facility Management, Project Management, Health & Safety, or a related field will be an added advantage.


Experience:


	Experience managing contractors, vendors, maintenance personnel, and service providers.
	Practical knowledge of building maintenance, electrical systems, plumbing, HVAC, generators, water systems, and other building services.
	Good understanding of occupational health and safety, fire safety, emergency procedures, and facility compliance requirements.
	Experience with maintenance planning, budgeting, procurement, and vendor management.


Required Skills and Competencies:
The ideal candidate should possess:


	Strong facility and maintenance management skills.
	Excellent organisational and time-management abilities.
	Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to supervise and coordinate technical and non-technical personnel.
	Strong attention to detail and ability to identify potential facility risks.
	Ability to manage multiple maintenance activities and priorities simultaneously.
	Good negotiation and vendor-management skills.
	Ability to prepare clear reports and maintain accurate records.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
	Ability to work independently and demonstrate sound judgement.
	High level of integrity, accountability, professionalism, and reliability.
	Ability to respond effectively to emergencies and urgent operational situations.


What We Offer


	A professional and dynamic working environment.
	Opportunity to contribute to the effective management and improvement of Company facilities.
	Career growth and professional development opportunities.
	Competitive remuneration based on experience and qualifications.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using "Facility Manager" as the subject of the mail.

title: Job Openings at TalentEase HR Services
content:
TalentEase HR Services is a strategic Human Resources consulting firm committed to helping organizations build stronger teams, develop effective people systems, and create workplaces where businesses and employees thrive.

We partner with startups, SMEs, and established organizations to deliver practical, compliant, and business-focused HR solutions tailored to their unique needs. Our expertise spans recruitment and talent acquisition, fractional HR, HR policy development, employee relations, performance management, HR compliance, workforce planning, onboarding, outsourcing, and organizational development.
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



At TalentEase HR Services, we believe Human Resources is more than an administrative function, it’s a strategic driver of growth, productivity, and long-term success. We work closely with our clients to align people strategies with business objectives, helping them attract top talent, improve employee engagement, strengthen workplace culture, and enhance organizational performance.

We are recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the following positions below:

1.) Social Media Content Creator (Graphics Designer & Video Editor)

Job Location: Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time
Work mode: Remote (Flexible Hours)

Job Overview


	We are seeking a creative and trend-savvy Social Media Content Creator who is skilled in both graphic design and video editing. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating, editing, and managing engaging visual content across our company and client digital platforms.
	The ideal candidate is a storyteller with an eye for aesthetics, who can translate ideas into scroll-stopping content that drives engagement and strengthens brand identity.


Key Responsibilities


	Edit and produce high-quality video content for social media, ads, and digital campaigns
	Create engaging short-form content including Reels, TikToks, Stories, graphics, flyers, and promotional materials
	Perform video editing tasks including color correction, motion graphics, sound synchronization, and visual enhancements where necessary
	Develop creative concepts and storytelling ideas that drive audience engagement and brand
	Design compelling graphics, banners, flyers and promotional materials
	Maintain visual consistency and brand aesthetics across all platforms
	Monitor social media trends, and create timely and relevant content
	Collaborate with internal teams to deliver content aligned with business and marketing goals
	Leverage AI-powered tools to improve content production efficiency and creativity


Requirements


	Proven experience as a Content Creator, Video Editor, Graphic Designer, or similar role
	Strong portfolio showing video editing and graphic design work
	Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, Canva or similar
	Solid understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube
	Experience using AI content creation tools is an added advantage.


Application Closing Date: 10th November, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV, Portfolio / Link to your previous works to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) Business Development Manager

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

Job Overview


	We are seeking a results-driven Business Development Manager to identify new business opportunities, build strong client relationships, and drive sustainable revenue growth.
	The successful candidate will play a key role in expanding our market presence and developing long-term partnerships.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify, develop, and secure new business opportunities through research, networking, and outreach.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients.
	Develop and execute strategic sales and business development plans.
	Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals.
	Negotiate contracts and close deals in line with company targets.
	Collaborate with marketing, sales, and operations teams to ensure successful delivery of solutions.
	Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer needs.
	Maintain accurate records of sales activities and forecasts using CRM systems.
	Achieve and exceed agreed revenue and growth targets.


Required Skills & Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field (preferred).
	Proven 2-5 years of experience as a Business Development Manager, Sales Manager, or similar role.
	Strong track record of achieving sales targets.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
	Ability to build rapport and influence decision-makers.
	Strategic thinker with a proactive, results-oriented mindset.
	Strong organizational and time-management skills.
	Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office tools.


What We Offer
N250,000 / Month plus performance-based commission, and apercentage of revenue generated.

Application Closing Date: 7th November , 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

3.)Sales / Marketing Officer

Job Location: Berger, Lagos and Arepo, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time (Monday to Friday)

Job Overview


	We are seeking a Sales and Marketing officer with previous experience in a real estate industry. The successful candidate will be responsible for marketing the company's products within Berger/Arepo environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Market the company's products within the Berger/Arepo environment
	Move around construction sites, schools, banks, and supermarkets within the area to market products
	Attend company meetings on Mondays and work in the field (Monday to Friday).


Requirements


	?Must have worked in a real estate environment
	Must reside within Berger/Arepo environment.


Salary & Benefits


	N100,000 - N200,000 monthly.
	Transport Allowance.


Application Closing Date: 7th November, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Executive Assistant",
  "description": "The People Office is an HR consulting firm that helps businesses build better teams, streamline HR processes, and create effective people management systems. We provide services including recruitment and talent placement, HR setup, employee management, policies and documentation, performance management, and organisational development. Our goal is to help growing businesses attract, manage, and retain the right talent while building structured, productive, and sustainable organisations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Executive Assistant

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Executive Office
Reports To:Creative Director

Job Summary


	The Executive Assistant (EA) will provide high-level administrative, organisational, and operational support to the Creative Directorensuring effective coordination of executive priorities, business activities, meetings, and strategic initiatives.
	The role requires a proactive and highly organised individual who can manage competing priorities, coordinate across departments, monitor the progress of assigned tasks, and ensure that important decisions and commitments are followed through.
	Working closely with the Managing Director and other members of the leadership team, the Executive Assistant will help improve executive efficiency, strengthen internal communication, and support the smooth running and growth of the business.


Key Responsibilities
Executive and Administrative Support:


	Manage the Managing Director&#39;s calendar, appointments, meetings, and business engagements.
	Prioritise meeting requests and ensure the CD&#39;stime is allocated effectively.
	Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, briefing notes, and other required documents.
	Manage executive correspondence and draft professional emails, letters, reports, and internal communications.
	Organise and maintain confidential executive records and documents.
	Anticipate the Managing Director&#39;s needs and proactively address administrative requirements.


Business Coordination and Follow-Up:


	Track the Managing Director&#39;s priorities, assignments, and commitments.
	Maintain an executive action tracker to monitor tasks, deadlines, responsible persons, and completion status.
	Follow up with department leads and employees on outstanding assignments and management directives.
	Ensure agreed action points from meetings are documented and completed within specified timelines.
	Escalate overdue tasks, operational challenges, and decisions requiring the Managing Director&#39;s attention.
	Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure alignment with business priorities.


Meeting and Communication Management:


	Schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings.
	Prepare meeting agendas and circulate relevant documents ahead of meetings.
	Record meeting minutes, decisions, and action points where required.
	Distribute meeting outcomes to relevant stakeholders and follow up on assigned responsibilities.
	Ensure effective communication between the Managing Director, employees, clients, vendors, and business partners.
	Handle confidential communications with professionalism and discretion.


Project and Operational Monitoring:


	Work with the Project Manager and other team leads to obtain updates on ongoing projects and business activities.
	Maintain a high-level overview of project milestones, deadlines, outstanding decisions, and significant risks.
	Track management approvals and follow up on pending decisions that may affect project delivery.
	Prepare consolidated updates for the Managing Director on operational progress and outstanding issues.
	Support coordination between design, procurement, project execution, finance, and administration teams.
	Escalate significant delays, resource constraints, or operational concerns to management.


&nbsp;xecutive Reporting and Information Management:


	Prepare weekly executive updates covering outstanding tasks, upcoming meetings, business priorities, and issues requiring attention.
	Compile information and reports from relevant departments for management review.
	Maintain organised records of executive decisions, business commitments, and key correspondence.
	Assist with the preparation of presentations, proposals, and management reports.
	Support the Managing Director in tracking progress against agreed business priorities.


Client and Stakeholder Coordination:


	Coordinate appointments and engagements with clients, suppliers, contractors, and business partners.
	Ensure the Managing Director is adequately briefed before important meetings.
	Follow up on agreed commitments and outstanding communications with stakeholders.
	Maintain professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
	Handle routine enquiries and direct matters to the appropriate department or individual.


Travel and Event Coordination:


	Coordinate business travel, accommodation, transportation, and itineraries.
	Organise logistics for client meetings, industry events, exhibitions, and company engagements.
	Assist with planning business meetings and corporate events.
	Ensure all necessary arrangements are completed ahead of scheduled engagements.


Confidentiality and Professional Conduct:


	Maintain strict confidentiality regarding company strategy, financial information, employee matters, and client records.
	Exercise sound judgement when handling sensitive matters on behalf of the Managing Director.
	Ensure confidential documents and communications are shared only with authorised individuals.
	Uphold the company&#39;s professional standards in all internal and external interactions.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The Executive Assistant&#39;s performance will be assessed against the following indicators:


	Executive Efficiency: Effective management of the Managing Director&#39;s schedule and priorities.
	Task Completion: Percentage of management action points followed up and completed within agreed timelines.
	Meeting Effectiveness: Timely preparation of agendas, meeting materials, minutes, and action trackers.
	Reporting Accuracy: Timely submission and accuracy of weekly executive reports.
	Follow-Up and Accountability: Effectiveness in tracking outstanding assignments and escalating overdue tasks.
	Communication Efficiency: Timely and professional handling of executive correspondence and stakeholder communication.
	Operational Visibility: Accuracy and timeliness of updates on projects, deadlines, and outstanding decisions.
	Confidentiality: Consistent protection of sensitive company and executive information.
	Planning and Coordination: Effective organisation of business meetings, travel, and other executive engagements.
	Proactiveness: Ability to anticipate needs, identify potential issues, and recommend practical solutions.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Business Administration, Management, Project Management, or a related field.
	1&ndash;2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Officer, Business Coordinator, or in a similar role.
	Previous experience supporting a CEO, Director, or senior executive is preferred.
	Experience working in an interior design, construction, architecture, real estate, or creative business is an advantage.
	Relevant professional certifications in executive assistance, administration, or project management are an added advantage.


Required Skills and Competencies:


	Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
	Strong written and verbal communication skills.
	High-level coordination, planning, and follow-up abilities.
	Strong problem-solving skills.
	Excellent attention to detail.
	Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
	Ability to prepare reports, presentations, and professional business correspondence.
	Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
	High levels of discretion, integrity, and confidentiality.
	Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgement.


Personal Attributes
The ideal candidate should be:


	Proactive and solutions-oriented.
	Highly organised and structured.
	Professional, dependable, and accountable.
	Confident in communicating with senior management and external stakeholders.
	Discreet and trustworthy.
	Ownership Mindset
	Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
	Able to anticipate problems and take appropriate initiative.
	Focused on execution, follow-through, and results.


Salary
N150,000 - N180,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: thepeopleoffice.hr@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",

Job Summary


	The Executive Assistant (EA) will provide high-level administrative, organisational, and operational support to the Creative Directorensuring effective coordination of executive priorities, business activities, meetings, and strategic initiatives.
	The role requires a proactive and highly organised individual who can manage competing priorities, coordinate across departments, monitor the progress of assigned tasks, and ensure that important decisions and commitments are followed through.
	Working closely with the Managing Director and other members of the leadership team, the Executive Assistant will help improve executive efficiency, strengthen internal communication, and support the smooth running and growth of the business.


Key Responsibilities
Executive and Administrative Support:


	Manage the Managing Director's calendar, appointments, meetings, and business engagements.
	Prioritise meeting requests and ensure the CD'stime is allocated effectively.
	Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, briefing notes, and other required documents.
	Manage executive correspondence and draft professional emails, letters, reports, and internal communications.
	Organise and maintain confidential executive records and documents.
	Anticipate the Managing Director's needs and proactively address administrative requirements.


Business Coordination and Follow-Up:


	Track the Managing Director's priorities, assignments, and commitments.
	Maintain an executive action tracker to monitor tasks, deadlines, responsible persons, and completion status.
	Follow up with department leads and employees on outstanding assignments and management directives.
	Ensure agreed action points from meetings are documented and completed within specified timelines.
	Escalate overdue tasks, operational challenges, and decisions requiring the Managing Director's attention.
	Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure alignment with business priorities.


Meeting and Communication Management:


	Schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings.
	Prepare meeting agendas and circulate relevant documents ahead of meetings.
	Record meeting minutes, decisions, and action points where required.
	Distribute meeting outcomes to relevant stakeholders and follow up on assigned responsibilities.
	Ensure effective communication between the Managing Director, employees, clients, vendors, and business partners.
	Handle confidential communications with professionalism and discretion.


Project and Operational Monitoring:


	Work with the Project Manager and other team leads to obtain updates on ongoing projects and business activities.
	Maintain a high-level overview of project milestones, deadlines, outstanding decisions, and significant risks.
	Track management approvals and follow up on pending decisions that may affect project delivery.
	Prepare consolidated updates for the Managing Director on operational progress and outstanding issues.
	Support coordination between design, procurement, project execution, finance, and administration teams.
	Escalate significant delays, resource constraints, or operational concerns to management.


 xecutive Reporting and Information Management:


	Prepare weekly executive updates covering outstanding tasks, upcoming meetings, business priorities, and issues requiring attention.
	Compile information and reports from relevant departments for management review.
	Maintain organised records of executive decisions, business commitments, and key correspondence.
	Assist with the preparation of presentations, proposals, and management reports.
	Support the Managing Director in tracking progress against agreed business priorities.


Client and Stakeholder Coordination:


	Coordinate appointments and engagements with clients, suppliers, contractors, and business partners.
	Ensure the Managing Director is adequately briefed before important meetings.
	Follow up on agreed commitments and outstanding communications with stakeholders.
	Maintain professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
	Handle routine enquiries and direct matters to the appropriate department or individual.


Travel and Event Coordination:


	Coordinate business travel, accommodation, transportation, and itineraries.
	Organise logistics for client meetings, industry events, exhibitions, and company engagements.
	Assist with planning business meetings and corporate events.
	Ensure all necessary arrangements are completed ahead of scheduled engagements.


Confidentiality and Professional Conduct:


	Maintain strict confidentiality regarding company strategy, financial information, employee matters, and client records.
	Exercise sound judgement when handling sensitive matters on behalf of the Managing Director.
	Ensure confidential documents and communications are shared only with authorised individuals.
	Uphold the company's professional standards in all internal and external interactions.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The Executive Assistant's performance will be assessed against the following indicators:


	Executive Efficiency: Effective management of the Managing Director's schedule and priorities.
	Task Completion: Percentage of management action points followed up and completed within agreed timelines.
	Meeting Effectiveness: Timely preparation of agendas, meeting materials, minutes, and action trackers.
	Reporting Accuracy: Timely submission and accuracy of weekly executive reports.
	Follow-Up and Accountability: Effectiveness in tracking outstanding assignments and escalating overdue tasks.
	Communication Efficiency: Timely and professional handling of executive correspondence and stakeholder communication.
	Operational Visibility: Accuracy and timeliness of updates on projects, deadlines, and outstanding decisions.
	Confidentiality: Consistent protection of sensitive company and executive information.
	Planning and Coordination: Effective organisation of business meetings, travel, and other executive engagements.
	Proactiveness: Ability to anticipate needs, identify potential issues, and recommend practical solutions.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Business Administration, Management, Project Management, or a related field.
	1–2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Officer, Business Coordinator, or in a similar role.
	Previous experience supporting a CEO, Director, or senior executive is preferred.
	Experience working in an interior design, construction, architecture, real estate, or creative business is an advantage.
	Relevant professional certifications in executive assistance, administration, or project management are an added advantage.


Required Skills and Competencies:


	Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
	Strong written and verbal communication skills.
	High-level coordination, planning, and follow-up abilities.
	Strong problem-solving skills.
	Excellent attention to detail.
	Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
	Ability to prepare reports, presentations, and professional business correspondence.
	Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
	High levels of discretion, integrity, and confidentiality.
	Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgement.


Personal Attributes
The ideal candidate should be:


	Proactive and solutions-oriented.
	Highly organised and structured.
	Professional, dependable, and accountable.
	Confident in communicating with senior management and external stakeholders.
	Discreet and trustworthy.
	Ownership Mindset
	Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
	Able to anticipate problems and take appropriate initiative.
	Focused on execution, follow-through, and results.


Salary
N150,000 - N180,000 monthly.
